headline: AWS packages SageMaker inference expertise as a reusable agent skill

source.title: New agent skill: Amazon SageMaker optimized generative AI inference for your coding agent

summary: AWS introduced the `aws-ai-ml` skill through the Agent Toolkit for AWS. It gives compatible coding assistants reusable expertise for benchmarking SageMaker endpoints, comparing performance, recommending configurations, and producing inspectable SageMaker Python SDK v3 code.
why_it_matters: This is a concrete example of a reusable Agent Skill rather than a one-off prompt. Teams can package specialist guidance once, load it where compatible, and keep recommendations tied to measured evidence and visible code.
related_coverage: The inference-latency story shows why the benchmarking and configuration decisions embodied in this skill matter at system level.
image_alt_intent: Pipeline diagram showing skill loading, intent capture, benchmark evidence, comparison, recommendation, and inspectable code.
